_help: Copy of this file lives in your project folder as project.json (`l2p init` writes it). Keys starting with _ are notes. Anything you leave out falls back to config/defaults.json.
name: plumbers-austin

area.name: Austin metro
area._help: Any of: bbox [south, west, north, east], center + radius_km, cities (lower-case names). A listing is kept if it matches any one.

offer.summary: A new mobile-first website built from the business's own brand, live in 14 days

plans.name: Launch
items: This exact page, finished with you

offer.care_plan: $39/month hosting, small edits and Google profile updates

sources._help: Paid, via Apify (compass~crawler-google-places). OFF by default. To use it: set enabled to true, put APIFY_TOKEN=... in .env (l2p doctor checks it), then `l2p collect` shows the cost (dry run) and `l2p collect --go` spends, stopping at budget_usd.
Free, on by default. OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API, inside area.bbox. Tags from wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Map_features.
Free. Any business directory with a sitemap and listing pages that carry JSON-LD or microdata. Only use sites you are allowed to crawl.
sources.name: example-directory

sources._help: Free. Your own list. map = your column names.

google_lookup._help: Paid. Looks up each non-Google business on Google Maps (rating, reviews, phone, website). One lookup per business, never repeated.

categories._help: category_group = first group whose keywords appear in the category or name. ticket = how much one client is worth.

scoring._help: Default signals and weights live in lib/score.mjs (DEFAULT_SIGNALS) and are listed in docs/SCORING.md. Put {"signal_id": weight} here to override; 0 switches a signal off.

community._help: Optional lens for one language community: boost or filter businesses whose names or reviews use a script.

compliance._help: CAN-SPAM (US), CASL (Canada), GDPR + national law (EU), PECR + UK-GDPR (UK), Spam Act (AU). See docs/COMPLIANCE.md.
compliance.sender_identity: Your Name, Your Studio, mailing address
